column1: # The run set of the future play spec (0.6.2 slice 15; decisions Q11, Q12, Q14, Q15, Q22 and the Tier B limits).
# Input of tests/seasons/future/run_set.py. One row per game.
# tier: A (RECOMP_TIER_A=1, slice 3), B (the full world, with the world-health checks and the Tier B limits), late (as
#   B, from the checkpoint save of the Tier A row in the column from, in the year start; open item 193),
#   jump (a new game in a far year, RECOMP_DATE_JUMP=1, the December 2025 database), normal (the full world, the
#   checker only; the quick set that tests the script).
# changing: changing rules on or off. nations: all, or names joined by commas. last: the last season (2100: the game
# plays the season 2100/01). leg_years: the seasons of one leg (one save and load each); a leg that ends in a new
# decade keeps its save as the checkpoint of that decade. set: release (the whole run set, Q12), nightly (also in the
# release set), quick (only with --set quick). status: run, or waits (with the reason in note).
